requirements.text: update the subscription contract for Zebra Partners to reflect the new quarterly pricing ... It should be set at 25.798k $
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract WHERE contract_id = 3 AND contract_type = 'subscription' AND status = 'active' AND contract_price = 25798
assumptions: Zebra Partners is account 2; of its two subscription contracts, 3 is active (price 19101 on the seed) and 132 expired, so the current one is 3
25.798k $ is 25798 in the integer contract_price column
the contract table has no billing-period column, so 'quarterly' is not a cell
contract_type and status kept from the benchmark check; the request leaves both unchanged

requirements.text: update the subscription contract for Zebra Partners
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract WHERE contract_id = 132 AND contract_price = 25841
assumptions: contract 132 is Zebra Partners' other subscription contract, expired; 'the subscription contract' names one contract, the active one, so 132's price does not change

requirements.text: if they're still using an IND number, go ahead and replace it with this Japan-based one instead: +81-90-1234-5678
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE user_id = 802 AND phone IS NULL
assumptions: the main contact is contact 124 (is_primary 1, the account's only contact), whose portal user is 802 (Pamela Morales)
her phone is empty, not an Indian (+91) number, so the condition for replacing it does not hold and no replacement is made

requirements.text: Make sure the main contact's location information is updated to reflect the Japan address with the street as Janice Landing, city as Tokyo, and country as Japan
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE user_id = 802 AND location_id = 803
assumptions: location 803 is the only location with street Janice Landing, city tokyo and country japan; user 802 points at location 802 (Tokyo, no street) on the seed
no listed tool writes the location table, so the update repoints the user to the existing location 803, as the benchmark check tests
the location sentence stands on its own and does not depend on the phone condition

notes:
The two independent passes agree on all four requirements (contract 3 at price 25798, contract 132 unchanged, user 802's phone left empty, user 802 moved to location 803) and on both dispositions (kept); no disagreements.
'Check phone of user' is a conjunction of two parts of the request: the phone that must stay empty (the Indian-number condition fails) and the location that must change to 803; it is carried by both requirements.
The phone value +81-90-1234-5678 is never required, since the main contact's phone is empty on the seed.
Location 803 is named 'Servicenow Hq - Tokyo' but is the only location at Janice Landing, Tokyo, Japan. Location 805 (Zebra Partners Hq - Tokyo) is in Tokyo but has no street, so it does not match the address given. Updating location 802 in place to street Janice Landing would also match the words, but no listed tool writes the location table and the seed already holds that address as location 803.
The acting user, Jose Roberson (user 32), has role admin but active 0 on the seed; the policy restricts inactive users only as case assignees and gives admins full access, so the request is treated as carried out. His own phone is an Indian number, but he is the requester, not Zebra Partners' main contact, so it is not in scope.
